newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling softens against dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling softens against dollar, pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling fell on Tuesday against both the dollar and pound in quiet trading, traders and the central Bank of Tanzania said.
The shilling traded at a commercial mean rate of 597.5640, slightly down from Monday's rate of 597.4650. Against the pound, the shilling exchanged at 995.6642, from 993.9748.

"It's been pretty quiet today. They (central bank) are trying to stabilise the shilling because it's been depreciating for some time now, but although it's on the high side I would still regard it as being relatively stable," one trader told Reuters
